latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Maker Free HD — create and export 1080p MP4 videos in the cloud, free for content creators.
- Upload video clips (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB), and generate HD videos with transitions and music.
- Simple setup with automatic backend connection and 100 free credits token for 7 days.
- Fast cloud rendering on GPU, typical exports ready in 1-2 minutes for short clips.
- Supports rich editing: aspect ratio, text overlays, audio tracks, timeline preview, and iterative workflow.
- Clear API integration, error handling, and support for common file types and workflows.
